name: Zhejiang Hangmin Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Hangmin Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textile dyeing, printing, and finishing business in China. The company offers various medium-to-high-grade cotton, linen, T/C, polyester-cotton, polyester-wool, and various chemical fiber fabrics or blended fabrics. It also exports its products to Southeast Asia, the Middle East, North America, the European Union, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
